_comment: AGE LEDGER — Modern Mythology vols 1-7 + prelude/meld/interlude scenes. Draft 1 (2026-10-16). Not applied to the repo.
Vols 1-4 scene ids and quotes come from origin/claude/vol1-4-source-text; vols 5-7 from claude/3d-locales-clean.
timeline: in-story year per volume / jumping chapter. year=null for the meld (outside time).

characters: keyed by roster base slug. era.look = the roster slug that should render that era (EXISTING or NEW in new_looks.json); null = unstaged (prose, photograph or lore only) — no model needed until a scene stages it.
era.voice.key = '<base>__<era>'; 'shares' names the existing voice_map key that can serve that era unchanged (age move < ~10 years). A new voice is needed where 'shares' is absent.
Ages are derived; each era has 'derivation' and 'source'. Conflicts are flagged, not resolved — see _flags.
edits: proposed changes to EXISTING roster entries. new looks live in new_looks.json.
